content.title: Selection Sunday: Where to watch the men’s NCAA Tournament selection show for free
content.text: Updated: Mar. 15, 2026, 4:00 p.m.Published: Mar. 15, 2026, 4:00 p.m.The Duke Blue Devils are projected to be the No. 1 overall seed in the NCAA men's basketball tournament. Find out how to watch Selection Sunday for free today. (AP Photo/Nell Redmond)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Jenna Malinowski | JMalinowski@mlive.comThe 2026 NCAA Tournament men’s bracket will officially be revealed tonight. Fans can tune into this year’s Selection Sunday show at 6 p.m. ET on CBS to see where their favorite team will end up. Streaming options are available through Fubo, DirecTV Stream and Paramount+, with free trials and first-month discounts available for new customers through Fubo and DirecTV Stream. Streaming OptionsTable not scrollableWhere will Michigan and Michigan State end up?Both the Michigan Wolverines and Michigan State Spartans are guaranteed to have their names called tonight. The Wolverines were ranked No. 3 and the Spartans were ranked No. 8 in the final AP Top 25 poll before the tournament. According to ESPN’s bracketology, the Wolverines are expected to receive the No. 1 seed in the Midwest region. The Spartans are expected to be named a No. 2 seed in the West region.
